_note: r.164(3)(i): "... or deduction of tax under section 160". s.160(1): a resident who paid income-tax on foreign income in a country with no agreement under s.159 is entitled to a deduction from Indian income-tax. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2026-27 only: r.164(1) governs "the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 2026" (D-520 C3a).
question: Are you claiming a deduction for income-tax paid in a country with which India has no double-taxation agreement (section 160)?

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-20032026-271092, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(3)(i), p.1662; Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.160, p.189
